package domain

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestEmptyStudentOnboardingDraftIsStableVersionZero(t *testing.T) {
	draft, err := EmptyStudentOnboardingDraft("11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if draft.Schema != StudentOnboardingDraftSchema || draft.Status != StudentOnboardingDraftStatusDraft ||
		draft.Version != 0 || hasDraftAnswers(draft.StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers) || draft.CreatedAt != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected empty draft: %+v", draft)
	}
	repeated, err := NormalizeStudentOnboardingDraft(draft)
	if err != nil || repeated != draft {
		t.Fatalf("empty draft is not stable: repeated=%+v err=%v", repeated, err)
	}
}

func TestNormalizeStudentOnboardingDraftAnswersValidatesEveryPartialField(t *testing.T) {
	text := func(value string) *string { return &value }
	integer := func(value int) *int { return &value }
	values := func(value ...string) *[]string { return &value }
	tests := []struct {
		name   string
		input  StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers
		assert func(t *testing.T, result StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers)
	}{
		{name: "direction", input: StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers{DirectionCode: text(" Backend ")}, assert: func(t *testing.T, result StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers) {
			if result.DirectionCode == nil || *result.DirectionCode != "backend" {
				t.Fatalf("direction=%v", result.DirectionCode)
			}
		}},
		{name: "experience", input: StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers{SelfAssessedExperience: text(" Basic ")}, assert: func(t *testing.T, result StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers) {
			if result.SelfAssessedExperience == nil || *result.SelfAssessedExperience != "basic" {
				t.Fatalf("experience=%v", result.SelfAssessedExperience)
			}
		}},
		{name: "known_stacks", input: StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers{KnownStacks: values(" Go ", "go")}, assert: func(t *testing.T, result StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers) {
			if result.KnownStacks == nil || len(*result.KnownStacks) != 1 || (*result.KnownStacks)[0] != "go" {
				t.Fatalf("known=%v", result.KnownStacks)
			}
		}},
		{name: "desired_stacks", input: StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers{DesiredStacks: values(" Docker ")}, assert: func(t *testing.T, result StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers) {
			if result.DesiredStacks == nil || len(*result.DesiredStacks) != 1 || (*result.DesiredStacks)[0] != "docker" {
				t.Fatalf("desired=%v", result.DesiredStacks)
			}
		}},
		{name: "goal_code", input: StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers{GoalCode: text(" First-Job ")}, assert: func(t *testing.T, result StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers) {
			if result.GoalCode == nil || *result.GoalCode != "first-job" {
				t.Fatalf("goal=%v", result.GoalCode)
			}
		}},
		{name: "goal_text", input: StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers{GoalText: text(" Получить работу ")}, assert: func(t *testing.T, result StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers) {
			if result.GoalText == nil || *result.GoalText != "Получить работу" {
				t.Fatalf("goal text=%v", result.GoalText)
			}
		}},
		{name: "language", input: StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers{PreferredLanguage: text(" RU ")}, assert: func(t *testing.T, result StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers) {
			if result.PreferredLanguage == nil || *result.PreferredLanguage != "ru" {
				t.Fatalf("language=%v", result.PreferredLanguage)
			}
		}},
		{name: "weekly_minutes", input: StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers{WeeklyMinutes: integer(300)}, assert: func(t *testing.T, result StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers) {
			if result.WeeklyMinutes == nil || *result.WeeklyMinutes != 300 {
				t.Fatalf("weekly=%v", result.WeeklyMinutes)
			}
		}},
		{name: "pace", input: StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers{PreferredPace: text(" Balanced ")}, assert: func(t *testing.T, result StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers) {
			if result.PreferredPace == nil || *result.PreferredPace != "balanced" {
				t.Fatalf("pace=%v", result.PreferredPace)
			}
		}},
	}
	for _, test := range tests {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			result, err := NormalizeStudentOnboardingDraftAnswers(test.input)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			test.assert(t, result)
		})
	}
}

func TestNormalizeStudentOnboardingDraftAnswersRejectsInvalidAnsweredValues(t *testing.T) {
	text := func(value string) *string { return &value }
	integer := func(value int) *int { return &value }
	values := func(value ...string) *[]string { return &value }
	tooMany := make([]string, 21)
	for index := range tooMany {
		tooMany[index] = "stack-" + string(rune('a'+index))
	}
	tests := []StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers{
		{DirectionCode: text("")},
		{SelfAssessedExperience: text("not valid")},
		{KnownStacks: &tooMany},
		{DesiredStacks: values()},
		{GoalCode: text("?")},
		{GoalText: text(strings.Repeat("界", 501))},
		{PreferredLanguage: text("r1")},
		{WeeklyMinutes: integer(0)},
		{PreferredPace: text("fast pace")},
	}
	for _, input := range tests {
		if _, err := NormalizeStudentOnboardingDraftAnswers(input); err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("invalid partial answer accepted: %+v", input)
		}
	}
}

func TestStudentOnboardingDraftPreservesAnsweredEmptyVersusUnanswered(t *testing.T) {
	emptyText := ""
	emptyStacks := []string{}
	answers, err := NormalizeStudentOnboardingDraftAnswers(StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers{
		GoalText: &emptyText, KnownStacks: &emptyStacks,
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(answers)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	text := string(encoded)
	if !strings.Contains(text, `"goal_text":""`) || !strings.Contains(text, `"known_stacks":[]`) ||
		strings.Contains(text, "direction_code") {
		t.Fatalf("empty/unanswered projection mismatch: %s", text)
	}
}

func TestBuildStudentOnboardingFromDraftRequiresCompleteProfileAndDefaultsOptionalFields(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 4, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	text := func(value string) *string { return &value }
	integer := func(value int) *int { return &value }
	values := func(value ...string) *[]string { return &value }
	draft, err := NormalizeStudentOnboardingDraft(StudentOnboardingDraft{
		Schema: StudentOnboardingDraftSchema, StudentID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		Status: StudentOnboardingDraftStatusDraft, Version: 1, CreatedAt: &now, UpdatedAt: &now,
		StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers: StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers{
			DirectionCode: text("backend"), SelfAssessedExperience: text("basic"),
			DesiredStacks: values("go"), GoalCode: text("first-job"), PreferredLanguage: text("ru"),
			WeeklyMinutes: integer(300), PreferredPace: text("balanced"),
		},
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	profile, err := BuildStudentOnboardingFromDraft(draft, 1, now, now)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if profile.Version != 1 || len(profile.KnownStacks) != 0 || profile.GoalText != "" {
		t.Fatalf("optional defaults mismatch: %+v", profile)
	}
	draft.PreferredPace = nil
	if _, err := BuildStudentOnboardingFromDraft(draft, 1, now, now); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("incomplete draft was finalized")
	}
}

func TestCompletedOnboardingDraftContainsNoAnswers(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	profileVersion := int64(2)
	draft, err := NormalizeStudentOnboardingDraft(StudentOnboardingDraft{
		Schema: StudentOnboardingDraftSchema, StudentID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		Status: StudentOnboardingDraftStatusCompleted, Version: 3,
		CompletedProfileVersion: &profileVersion, CreatedAt: &now, UpdatedAt: &now, CompletedAt: &now,
	})
	if err != nil || hasDraftAnswers(draft.StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers) {
		t.Fatalf("valid completed draft rejected: draft=%+v err=%v", draft, err)
	}
	value := "backend"
	draft.DirectionCode = &value
	if _, err := NormalizeStudentOnboardingDraft(draft); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("completed draft exposed retained answers")
	}
}

func TestTeacherStudentOnboardingStateIsBoundedAndCompletedDraftStaysRedacted(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	completedProfileVersion := int64(2)
	draft, err := NormalizeStudentOnboardingDraft(StudentOnboardingDraft{
		Schema: StudentOnboardingDraftSchema, StudentID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		Status: StudentOnboardingDraftStatusCompleted, Version: 3,
		CompletedProfileVersion: &completedProfileVersion, CreatedAt: &now, UpdatedAt: &now, CompletedAt: &now,
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	state, err := NewTeacherStudentOnboardingState(draft, 4)
	if err != nil || state.Schema != TeacherStudentOnboardingStateSchema || state.ProfileVersion != 4 ||
		hasDraftAnswers(state.Draft.StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers) {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected Teacher onboarding state: state=%+v err=%v", state, err)
	}
	payload, err := json.Marshal(state)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, forbidden := range []string{"direction_code", "mastery", "learning_path", "receipt", "request_hash", "audit"} {
		if strings.Contains(string(payload), forbidden) {
			t.Fatalf("Teacher onboarding state leaked %q: %s", forbidden, payload)
		}
	}
	if _, err := NewTeacherStudentOnboardingState(draft, 1); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("state accepted a profile version older than completed draft")
	}
}
